guidelines: Staggered entrance animations for invoice tables and client metrics (stagger: 0.05s)
Interactive status pill transitions on payment recording (scale: 0.98 -> 1.0, opacity: 0 -> 1)
Smooth accordion transitions for GST breakdowns and calculation details
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable spring transitions when requested

accessibility.contrast_minimum: 4.5:1 for body and data cells, 3:1 for large display headers
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for action buttons and table controls
accessibility.aria_annotations: Mandatory aria-label for icon-only action triggers, status chips, and PDF download buttons

instructions_to_main_agent: REBRAND BILLNEST TO COLLECTFLOW: Replace every occurrence of 'BillNest' with 'CollectFlow' across all marketing copy, page headers, document templates, PDF exports, and dashboard widgets.

INDIAN LOCALE & GST SUPPORT: Support INR (₹) formatting with lakhs/crores or standard Indian comma grouping (e.g. ₹1,45,000), support 18% / 12% / 5% GST calculations (CGST+SGST or IGST), and provide GSTIN validation helpers.

FULL FEATURE PARITY: Retain and enhance all core modules: Persistent MongoDB client management, full invoice builder with line-items, tax calculation, PDF download preview, manual payment recording, aging buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days), and automated reminder logs.

DATA-TESTID EVERYWHERE: Ensure all actionable buttons, table rows, inputs, modal triggers, and status badges include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='create-invoice-button', data-testid='record-payment-button', data-testid='client-row-xyz').
ZERO BLANK PAGES ON CDN: When API fetches fail or backend is sleeping, show rich fallback states with seeded demo data toggles rather than crashing or showing bare error banners.
